title: Try project-auto-wizard in 5 minutes
subtitle: Browser only  ·  No install  ·  No secrets  ·  Real GitHub Actions

steps.01-use-template: Open the example repository and click Use this template
steps.02-create-copy: Create your own copy (leave Include all branches off)
steps.03-create-develop: Create a develop branch from main
steps.04-edit-code: Change the code on develop in the web editor
steps.05-commit-feat: Commit with a type: feat: means the next minor version
steps.06-open-pr: Open a pull request from develop to main
steps.07-bot-merges: Within a minute the bot writes the release notes and merges
steps.08-release: Tag and GitHub Release v0.3.0 are published
steps.09-changelog: CHANGELOG.md is written from the commit messages

end_title: Your next release, from a commit message
